basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old collector and builder from Toronto, Canada. I've been into construction sets since I was a kid, and Mega Construx is my go-to for anything Halo-related. I work as a graphic designer by day and spend my evenings tinkering with new builds or sharing tips on Reddit. I’m a big fan of Kendrick Lamar, and his music often fuels my creative sessions. When I'm not building or online, I enjoy biking around Toronto's trails. I'm in a long-term relationship with someone who shares my passion for creativity and exploration. I generally log in to Reddit during the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of Mega Construx sets, particularly the Halo series, gained through years of personal collection and community interactions. I also have a strong background in design, which helps in customizing and creating unique builds. My knowledge is self-taught, supplemented by online resources and community forums.
